title: NovaCorp Vacation & PTO Policy
content:
NovaCorp Vacation and Paid Time Off Policy — Effective January 1, 2025

1. VACATION ACCRUAL
All regular full-time employees accrue paid vacation at a rate of 1.67 days per month (20 days per year). Part-time employees working at least 20 hours per week accrue vacation on a pro-rata basis. Employees begin accruing vacation from their first day of employment; however, vacation may not be taken during the first 90 days of employment without prior VP approval.

2. VACATION SCHEDULING
All vacation requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 5 business days in advance for absences of 3 days or fewer, and at least 15 business days in advance for absences longer than 3 days. All requests are subject to manager approval. Managers will make reasonable efforts to accommodate vacation requests while ensuring adequate coverage.

3. CARRYOVER AND CAPS
Up to 10 unused vacation days may be carried over to the following calendar year. Any accrued vacation exceeding 10 days that is unused at year-end will be forfeited. Employees may not accrue more than 25 days at any time (accrual cap). No vacation payout is made upon termination except in jurisdictions requiring it by law.

4. CONSECUTIVE LEAVE
Employees wishing to take more than 15 consecutive business days off must obtain approval from their VP and the HR department at least 30 days in advance. Extended leaves of more than 20 consecutive days may be subject to review under the Personal Leave policy.

5. SICK LEAVE
Sick leave is separate from vacation. Employees accrue 1.25 sick days per month (15 days per year). Sick leave does not carry over and cannot be cashed out. Medical certification may be required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days.

6. PUBLIC HOLIDAYS
NovaCorp observes 10 federal holidays per year. A list of observed holidays is published annually in January. Employees required to work on a designated holiday will receive compensatory time off at 1.5x rate.
